name: Eiheiji (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Eiheiji town emblem in blue: a stylised swirl of a curved stroke with two discs.
history: Municipal flag of Eiheiji, a town in Fukui Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 13 February 2006.

features.role: Eiheiji town emblem — a stylised swirl of a curved stroke with two discs
